capabilities: Save pasted images with note-based names and clean up unreferenced files to .trash
Edit and reorganize note content in an editable Markdown mind map that writes back to the source file
Chat with an AI assistant that reads long-term memory, progress logs, and configured notes
Color-code file names by extension in the file list
Configure OpenAI-compatible API endpoints, keys, and models in a Markdown config file
disambiguation: Despite the journal-related name, it is not a diary or daily-notes tool; it bundles image management, a mind map editor, and an AI assistant panel.
extras: Documentation and interface are primarily Chinese with an English option; API keys are stored in plaintext inside the plugin folder; manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian's default image pasting gives generic names and leaves orphaned files, and there is no built-in editable mind map view or AI chat that keeps its memory in local Markdown files.

relations.evidence: 支持兼容 OpenAI Chat Completions 的接口，也支持以完整 /chat/completions 路径填写地址。

summary: Toolkit that auto-names and cleans up pasted images, edits notes through a Markdown mind map, and offers a chat AI assistant with local Markdown memory.
